description: Semiconductor physics decomposed. Direct vs indirect bandgap, density of states, Fermi-Dirac distribution, intrinsic vs extrinsic carriers, mobility + drift, recombination, heterojunctions, quantum wells, 2D materials.

sub_mechanisms.name: direct_vs_indirect_bandgap
sub_mechanisms.definition: Direct: VBM + CBM at same k. Indirect: different k. Phonon needed for indirect.
sub_mechanisms.why: GaAs direct → efficient LED, laser. Si indirect → poor light emission. Foundation of opto-electronics.

sub_mechanisms.name: density_of_states
sub_mechanisms.definition: DOS(E) dE = number of states in energy range. ∝ √(E-Ec) in 3D bulk.
sub_mechanisms.why: Quantum wells, wires, dots have different DOS. 2D: step function; 1D: 1/√E; 0D: delta. Drives device physics.

sub_mechanisms.name: Fermi_Dirac_distribution
sub_mechanisms.definition: f(E) = 1/(1+exp((E-Ef)/kT)). Probability state occupied at temperature T.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of semiconductor carrier concentration. n = ∫ DOS(E) f(E) dE. Universal in solid state.

sub_mechanisms.name: intrinsic_carrier_density
sub_mechanisms.definition: n_i = √(Nc Nv) exp(-Eg/2kT). Pure semiconductor carrier concentration.
sub_mechanisms.why: Si at 300K: ni = 10^10/cm³. Strong T dependence. Foundation: doping must exceed ni for extrinsic behavior.

sub_mechanisms.name: mobility_drift_velocity
sub_mechanisms.definition: μ relates drift velocity to field: v_d = μE. Si electron mobility ~1400 cm²/Vs.
sub_mechanisms.why: Determines conductivity σ = nqμ. Phonon + impurity scattering limit. Foundation of transport.

sub_mechanisms.name: Hall_effect
sub_mechanisms.definition: Magnetic field on current → transverse voltage. Sign reveals carrier type.
sub_mechanisms.why: n vs p identification. Measure carrier density + mobility. Standard semiconductor characterisation.

sub_mechanisms.name: recombination_radiative
sub_mechanisms.definition: Electron + hole recombine, emit photon. Foundation of LED.
sub_mechanisms.why: Direct bandgap semiconductors. GaAs, GaN, InGaN. Efficiency depends on bandgap directness.

sub_mechanisms.name: recombination_Shockley_Read_Hall
sub_mechanisms.definition: Defects in bandgap act as trap. Non-radiative recombination.
sub_mechanisms.why: Limits LED efficiency. Solar cells too. Material quality = defect density. Foundation.

sub_mechanisms.name: Auger_recombination
sub_mechanisms.definition: Three-body: electron-hole pair recombines, gives energy to third carrier.
sub_mechanisms.why: Dominates at high carrier density. Limits high-brightness LEDs. Direct gap. Fundamental physics.

sub_mechanisms.name: heterojunction_band_alignment
sub_mechanisms.definition: Two semiconductors with different bandgaps. Type I (straddling), II (staggered), III (broken).
sub_mechanisms.why: Confines carriers in narrow-gap region. Foundation of quantum well lasers, HEMTs, multi-junction solar.

sub_mechanisms.name: quantum_well_2D
sub_mechanisms.definition: Thin (<10 nm) layer between wider-gap barriers. Quantised energy levels.
sub_mechanisms.why: Diode lasers, blue LEDs (InGaN QW), HEMTs. Wavelength tunable by well width. Standard photonics.

sub_mechanisms.name: 2D_materials_TMDC
sub_mechanisms.definition: Transition Metal Dichalcogenides. MoS2, WSe2. Direct gap monolayer, indirect in bulk.
sub_mechanisms.why: Beyond Si. Monolayer: 1 nm thick. Flexible electronics, photonics. Active research → emerging products.

derivation_rules.name: direct_bandgap_enables_efficient_LEDs
derivation_rules.why: Direct: photon emission only needs to satisfy energy + momentum (same k). Indirect needs phonon = much rarer. GaN blue, GaAs IR LEDs.

derivation_rules.name: mobility_determined_by_scattering
then: mobility μ = qτ/m* where τ is scattering time
derivation_rules.why: Higher mobility = faster devices. Doping decreases (more impurity scattering). High-mobility 2DEG in HEMTs.

derivation_rules.name: quantum_confinement_blue_shifts_emission
if: semiconductor layer is thin enough for confinement
derivation_rules.why: Particle in box: E ∝ 1/L². InGaN blue LEDs: thinner = bluer. Standard QW design.

derivation_rules.name: heterojunction_carrier_confinement
derivation_rules.why: Type I band alignment: electrons + holes both confined. High carrier density → high gain → laser. Foundation of QW lasers.

derivation_rules.name: SRH_recombination_limited_by_defects
derivation_rules.why: Defects = traps in bandgap. Carriers recombine non-radiatively. Limits LED efficiency, solar cells. Material quality critical.
